statusLine.command: b=$(jq -r '[.plugins | to_entries[] | select(.key | startswith("senior-mode@")) | .value[].installPath] | last // empty' "$HOME/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json" 2>/dev/null)/bin/senior-mode; [ -x "$b" ] || b=$(ls -d "$HOME"/.claude/plugins/cache/*/senior-mode/*/bin/senior-mode 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -1); [ -x "$b" ] && exec "$b" statusline; exit 0
